write_plan
parameters: {"content": "Plan for Monday, Oct 12: 
- Pay market entry fee first (keep $20 reserve). Current cash $80; after fee expect $60 available.
- Keep prices as set. Focus on selling high-margin items first: rice ($9), sesame oil ($7), miso ($6), dried noodles ($6), soy sauce ($4). These will keep profit per sale healthy.
- Negotiation policy: allow haggles but protect margins. Single-item discounts up to 15% if it still yields >= cost+0.50. Bundles: 3+ items get 20% off or a free low-cost bonus (one chopsticks set or one soap) for purchases over $25. Do not accept offers that would leave us below cost or that reduce our cash reserve below $20.
- Promotions: Offer 'meal bundle' (dried noodles + miso + soy sauce) at a modest bundle discount to encourage higher spend. For purchases over $30, offer one free chopsticks set (inventory permitting). Track bonus items in deals precisely.
- Restocking: Do not place standard supplier orders that would not arrive by Monday. If mid-week inventory falls, consider ordering 5 rice and 5 soy_sauce after assessing cash at close; only restock if we can maintain $20 reserve.
- Supplier interactions: use private_message to negotiate specialty items only if a customer specifically requests something we don’t stock. Place_supplier_order after agreeing on price.
- Goal: protect cash to pay next entry fee, sell through best sellers, keep margins healthy, and avoid overstocking. "}

write_plan
parameters: {"content": "Monday Oct 12 reflection and plan for next market session (Tue Oct 13):

Summary of today:
- Market closed. Sales: 11 items sold, revenue $58.00. Cash on hand: $118.00. Inventory updated.
- High-margin items (rice, sesame oil, miso) sold well; competitors undercut noodles/soy/ sesame oil on price in the market—maintain margin discipline.

Goals for Tue Oct 13:
- Keep listed prices unchanged to preserve margins and consistency for returning customers.
- Continue promotions: Meal bundle (dried noodles + miso + soy) at 20% off ($12.80), 3+ items get 20% off or free Lacquered Chopstick Set for purchases > $30. Allow single-item discounts up to 15% only if final price >= cost + $0.50.
- Prioritize selling rice, sesame oil, and miso to protect profit.

Restocking policy:
- Defer standard restock now. Plan to consider a standard order of 5 Short-grain Rice (2kg) and 5 Soy Sauce (500ml) on Wednesday morning only if cash after Tuesday close >= $50 (this preserves the $20 entry-fee reserve plus the $30 order cost). Estimated cost if ordered: $30 (rice cost $4 x5 = $20; soy cost $2 x5 = $10).
- Do not place any supplier orders for customers until I get and pass along firm Hayashi Supply quotes and receive customer confirmation. For Haruki’s pork request: wait for Hayashi’s firm quote, confirm with Haruki, then place a specialty order only if Haruki confirms and the total cost is acceptable to him.

Operational items:
- Prepare price tags and bundle signage for tomorrow.
- Keep $20 cash reserve at all times; do not accept deals that will leave cash below this.
- Track competitor promotions and be ready to slightly adjust haggling flexibility within existing discount rules if necessary.

Notes for follow-up:
- Hayashi Supply has been asked for a firm quote on 700 g boneless pork belly for Haruki — do not place any order until their reply and Haruki’s confirmation.
- If cash grows above thresholds mid-week, consider a replenishment order sooner, but only after confirming it won’t jeopardize the entry-fee reserve.

End of plan."}

parameters: {"content": "Plan for Monday, Oct 12: 
- Pay market entry fee first (keep $20 reserve). Current cash $80; after fee expect $60 available.
- Keep prices as set. Focus on selling high-margin items first: rice ($9), sesame oil ($7), miso ($6), dried noodles ($6), soy sauce ($4). These will keep profit per sale healthy.
- Negotiation policy: allow haggles but protect margins. Single-item discounts up to 15% if it still yields >= cost+0.50. Bundles: 3+ items get 20% off or a free low-cost bonus (one chopsticks set or one soap) for purchases over $25. Do not accept offers that would leave us below cost or that reduce our cash reserve below $20.
- Promotions: Offer 'meal bundle' (dried noodles + miso + soy sauce) at a modest bundle discount to encourage higher spend. For purchases over $30, offer one free chopsticks set (inventory permitting). Track bonus items in deals precisely.
- Restocking: Do not place standard supplier orders that would not arrive by Monday. If mid-week inventory falls, consider ordering 5 rice and 5 soy_sauce after assessing cash at close; only restock if we can maintain $20 reserve.
- Supplier interactions: use private_message to negotiate specialty items only if a customer specifically requests something we don’t stock. Place_supplier_order after agreeing on price.
- Goal: protect cash to pay next entry fee, sell through best sellers, keep margins healthy, and avoid overstocking. "}
